From early concepts to final pieces, get an inside look at how one of Pokémon’s milestone anniversaries was translated into wearable fandom. Whether you're a longtime Trainer or just love seeing how fandom products come together, this is a peek behind the curtain you won’t want to skip.Keep WatchingNext video in 8 secondsMore Videos Alex was the sick wife of Henry Miller who was diagnosed with Huntington's disease. Contents 1 Biography 2 Appearances 2.1 Season 2 3 Behind the scenes 4 References Biography[] Alex lays in bed ill as Henry injects her with a lethal dose to end her suffering. He tells her goodbye and assures her that he'll be reunited with her soon, as Billy Pace has arrived to kill him so that Sinatra can acquire his product to ensure the functionality of the bunker.[1] Appearances[] Season 2[] Another Day in Paradise Behind the scenes[] Alex is portrayed by Gwen Holloway.
